cards.example_en: Our group ran a survey on how classmates travel.
cards.example_zh: 我们小组做了一项关于同学如何出行的调查。

cards.example_en: Few plants can survive without water.
cards.example_zh: 很少植物能在没有水的情况下存活。

cards.example_en: Take a sweater in case it is cold.
cards.example_zh: 带件毛衣，以防天气冷。

cards.example_en: I sweep the classroom on Mondays.
cards.example_zh: 我周一打扫教室。

cards.example_en: The sweet mangoes from the market were gone by evening.
cards.example_zh: 从市场买来的甜芒果到傍晚就吃完了。

cards.example_en: We swim in the indoor pool on cold winter days.
cards.example_zh: 寒冷的冬日里，我们在室内泳池游泳。

cards.example_en: The olive branch is a symbol of peace in the play.
cards.example_zh: 在这部话剧里，橄榄枝是和平的象征。

cards.example_en: The books are on the table.
cards.example_zh: 书在桌子上。

cards.example_en: The cat's tail knocked a cup off the low table.
cards.example_zh: 猫的尾巴把矮桌上的杯子碰掉了。

cards.example_en: You ought to take an umbrella because the sky looks grey.
cards.example_zh: 天色看起来灰蒙蒙的，你应该带一把伞。

cards.example_en: She has a real talent for music.
cards.example_zh: 她对音乐有真正的天赋。

cards.example_en: My uncle likes to talk with neighbours over the fence.
cards.example_zh: 我叔叔喜欢隔着篱笆和邻居谈话。

cards.example_en: The tall player could reach the basket without jumping.
cards.example_zh: 那位高个子队员不用起跳就能碰到篮筐。

cards.example_en: Please turn off the tap.
cards.example_zh: 请把水龙头关掉。

cards.example_en: A piece of clear tape held the torn map together.
cards.example_zh: 一小段透明胶带把撕破的地图粘在了一起。

cards.example_en: Sorting the library books became my task on Friday.
cards.example_zh: 星期五，整理图书馆的书成了我的任务。

cards.example_en: I prefer the taste of warm milk to cold milk.
cards.example_zh: 比起冰牛奶，我更喜欢热牛奶的味道。

cards.example_en: The taxi arrived late, so we ran into assembly.
cards.example_zh: 出租车来晚了，我们只好跑着去参加晨会。

cards.example_en: Grandpa drinks weak tea with no milk every evening.
cards.example_zh: 爷爷每天晚上都喝不加奶的淡茶。

cards.example_en: Grandma can teach us how to make steamed buns.
cards.example_zh: 奶奶能教我们怎样做馒头。

cards.example_en: Our maths teacher stayed late to mark our graphs.
cards.example_zh: 我们的数学老师留到很晚，批改我们的图表。

cards.example_en: The relay team dropped the baton on the last bend.
cards.example_zh: 接力队在最后一个弯道掉了接力棒。

cards.example_en: The project needs good teamwork.
cards.example_zh: 这个项目需要良好的团队合作。

cards.example_en: New technology lets farmers water fields from home.
cards.example_zh: 新技术让农民在家里就能给田地浇水。

cards.example_en: The book is written for teenage readers.
cards.example_zh: 这本书是写给青少年读者的。

cards.example_en: I will tell the driver where I need to get off.
cards.example_zh: 我会告诉司机我要在哪里下车。

cards.example_en: The temperature dropped below zero last night.
cards.example_zh: 昨晚气温降到零度以下。

cards.example_en: Rain cancelled tennis, so we played cards indoors.
cards.example_zh: 下雨取消了网球，我们就改在室内打牌。

cards.example_en: We put up our tent next to the river.
cards.example_zh: 我们把帐篷搭在河边。

cards.example_en: The autumn term ends two days before Christmas.
cards.example_zh: 秋季学期在圣诞节前两天结束。

cards.example_en: A terrible headache kept me home from the match.
cards.example_zh: 我头疼得厉害，没能去看那场比赛。

cards.example_en: Open your test only when the teacher starts the clock.
cards.example_zh: 等老师开始计时，再打开测试卷。

cards.example_en: Copy the text from the board into your notebook.
cards.example_zh: 把黑板上的文本抄到你的笔记本里。

cards.example_en: She is taller than her brother.
cards.example_zh: 她比她哥哥高。

cards.example_en: We thank the cooks when the festival dinner ends.
cards.example_zh: 节日晚宴结束时，我们感谢厨师们。

cards.example_en: That book on the desk is mine.
cards.example_zh: 桌上的那本书是我的。

cards.example_en: The library opens at nine o'clock.
cards.example_zh: 图书馆九点开门。

cards.example_en: Our class booked seats at the theatre for Friday.
cards.example_zh: 我们班订了星期五去剧院的座位。

cards.example_en: Their house is next to the park.
cards.example_zh: 他们的房子在公园旁边。

cards.meaning_zh: 他们的（单独使用，不加名词）
cards.example_en: Those bags are theirs, not ours.
cards.example_zh: 那些包是他们的，不是我们的。

cards.example_en: I saw them at the sports centre.
cards.example_zh: 我在体育中心看见他们了。

cards.example_en: They cooked dinner themselves.
cards.example_zh: 他们自己做了晚饭。

cards.example_en: First wash your hands, then eat.
cards.example_zh: 先洗手，然后再吃。

cards.example_en: There is a cat under the table.
cards.example_zh: 桌子底下有一只猫。

cards.example_en: It rained, therefore we stayed inside.
cards.example_zh: 下雨了，因此我们待在室内。

cards.example_en: These apples look fresh and sweet.
cards.example_zh: 这些苹果看起来又新鲜又甜。

cards.example_en: They play tennis every weekend.
cards.example_zh: 他们每个周末打网球。

cards.example_en: Mom cut a thick slice of bread for breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈早餐时切了一片厚面包。

cards.example_en: The ice on the pond looks thin after the rain.
cards.example_zh: 雨后，池塘上的冰看起来很薄。

cards.example_en: Losing the bus ticket was the worst thing all week.
cards.example_zh: 把公共汽车票弄丢了，是这一周最糟糕的事。

word.example_en: Do not talk with food in your mouth at table.
word.example_zh: 用餐时嘴里有食物就别说话。

word.example_en: She wants to take up painting.
The plane will take off in ten minutes.
Take out your pencil, please.
Please take away the empty cups.
Take care on the icy road.
I need to talk to the librarian.
word.example_zh: 我需要和图书管理员讲话。

word.example_en: She likes to talk with her neighbours.
We talk about our weekend in class.
The teacher wants to have a talk with you.
They went to the station by taxi.
We take a taxi when it rains hard.
word.example_zh: 下大雨时我们打出租车。

word.example_en: The nurse will take your temperature.
We have a test on verbs tomorrow.
She spoke slowly so that we could follow.
word.example_zh: 她说得很慢，以便我们能跟上。

word.example_en: The film was so funny that we all laughed.
word.example_zh: 电影如此有趣，我们都笑了。

word.example_en: It was such a hot day that we stayed inside.
word.example_zh: 天热成这样，我们只好待在室内。

word.example_en: I was ten at that time.
In that case, we can meet tomorrow.
word.example_zh: 既然那样，我们可以明天见。

word.example_en: From then on, they became good friends.
word.example_zh: 从那时起，他们成了好朋友。

word.example_en: We visit the museum now and then.
There are flowers here and there in the yard.
